Sometimes a lumberjack, {npc:Chip}, shows up illegally cutting the royal trees in the fields north of Carlin and buys {item:Wood|pieces of wood}. Talk to him and then report him to {npc:Queen Eloise} to get the achievement Whistle-Blower.
Someone is illegally cutting down trees in the forests north of Carlin, and Queen Eloise is not at all happy.
Only possible while this Mini World Change is active in your world.
While Chip is present, you can sell him {item:Wood} for 50 gp each
You have to talk to {npc:Chip} **before** talking to Queen Eloise, otherwise she only answers *"How would you know?"*.
1. How to tell it is active
When this Mini World Change is active, messages like these appear. They only appear while nobody has told the queen about the lumberjack yet.
Go to the fields north of Carlin

Go to the {wiki:Fields of Glory}, the fields between Ab'Dendriel and Carlin, where the lumberjack {npc:Chip} is cutting down the trees north of Carlin. There are no caves on the way: leave Carlin and walk **north** on the surface to Chip. After talking to him, walk back **south** the same way to Carlin.
Say {key:hi} and {key:queen}. If you like, take the chance to sell him {item:Wood} (50 gp each).

Go to the castle of **Carlin** and talk to {npc:Queen Eloise}: say {key:hail queen} and then {key:lumberjack} (or {key:Chip}). If you are the first to tell her, she asks for confirmation: answer {key:yes}. You get the achievement **Whistle-Blower**.
If someone has already told her, she answers: *"Yes, I know. I've sent some of my amazons to get rid of him."*
